crossRefs.note: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.
In that day Yahweh made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of…
Live in this land, and I will be with you, and will bless you. For I will give to you, and to your offspring, all these…
Behold, Yahweh stood above it, and said, “I am Yahweh, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac. I will…
I gave you a land on which you had not labored, and cities which you didn’t build, and you live in them. You eat of…
They took fortified cities and a rich land, and possessed houses full of all good things, cisterns dug out, vineyards…
He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to…
He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: It shall be, when Yahweh your God brings you into the land which he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you, great and goodly cities which you didn’t build,
translations.bsb: And when the LORD your God brings you into the land He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He would give you—a land with great and splendid cities that you did not build,
translations.kjv: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst
translations.asv: And it shall be, when Jehovah thy God shall bring thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee, great and goodly cities, which thou buildest not,
